commits.subject: Restore the BlueValues the releases were exported with
commits.body:
FontForge exported both releases from src/Rambla-Bold.otf and
src/Rambla-BoldItalic.otf (tools/generate/HOWTOGEN.txt) and snapped
their OS/2 x-height and cap height to these zones. The -TTF.sfd files
re-import those TTFs (ttf2sfd.py), which cannot carry a private
dictionary. Value: each .otf's CFF Private BlueValues (identical).
